_readme: Hand-maintained inventory of behaviour changes worth tracking. live-state.mjs
reads this and works out, per feature, whether it is actually in production.
Each feature declares the files it lives in, and for each file a 'marker' -
a literal string that must be present for the change to be considered
implemented. The marker is what makes this honest: without it, a file that
was reverted still looks like the feature is there.
functions[] and migrations[] point at things that ship separately from the
frontend, so a feature can be half-live: UI deployed, migration never run.
Add an entry whenever you build something you would be annoyed to lose track of.

features.name: Onboarding keeps the answers it collects
features.what: Company profile writes onboarded_at and trade_role, and the gate closes as well as opens, so the modal stops reappearing on every reload.

features.name: Paywall off for demos
features.what: Gating is behind VITE_ENFORCE_PAYWALL, so every screen is reachable unless that env var is set to 'true'.
features.note: Live behaviour also depends on the Vercel env var, which this script cannot read.

features.name: Alerts are relevant and readable
features.what: Feed HTML and double-escaped entities are stripped, duplicates dropped, and only product-relevant items stay critical.

features.name: Sidebar logo is not a 4 MB PNG
features.what: Inline shield SVG plus wordmark, replacing the white-boxed logo.png.

features.name: Dashboard shows real unclaimed RoDTEP
features.what: Dashboard prefers the figure computed from actual shipping bills over the turnover-band estimate, and captions which one it used.

features.name: Trade agreement status comes from the database
features.what: fta_agreements overlays the built-in table at runtime, and the screen shows how old the data is.

features.name: CBAM emissions use EU default values
features.what: climatiq-emissions looks up the CBAM default for the HS code's CN prefix instead of failing, and the panel appears once rather than per market.

features.name: DGFT Certificate of Origin - Phase 1
features.what: Maps a shipment onto the DGFT CoO payload, validates it before submission, and carries the reference maps. No live DGFT call yet.
features.note: Blocked on three unanswered questions: credential tenancy, fixed egress IP for DGFT's whitelist, RSA key custody.

features.name: RISK: self-made Certificate of Origin PDF
features.what: downloadCOOPdf draws a document headed CERTIFICATE OF ORIGIN with a locally generated reference number. No agency issued it. This should be withdrawn or relabelled before any customer uses it.
features.note: Here so it stays visible. Present = the risk is still shipped.

features.name: Demo seed for Meridian Tubes & Alloys
features.what: Re-runnable seed with 8 shipments, IGST claims, BRC/FIRC and licences, for demoing to a real exporter.
features.note: Pasted into the SQL editor by hand; not a migration, so it is not tracked as applied.
